doc.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18

title: Selling his own tonic on the side, $20 a week, and Doc's reaction to a doctor
summary: He made extra money selling his own bottles, earned $20 a week, and Doc was furious when he called a real doctor after bad moonshine.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Because after I got the formula, I would get a room sometime in Townsend, manufacture a little myself, and sell it on the side. On the side? Oh, yeah. Well,
make a little extra money after all. Did you know you were doing that? $20 a week is kind of hard to live on.
Is that what you were getting? $20 a week? $20 a week. Yes. And room and board. Yeah. Did they feed you on that money, or did you have to get your own food? You had to get your own food.

They didn't have any cookhouse on this thing. You had to get your own food. What did they sell it for? A bottle. A dollar. One dollar. How much did they buy? Was it a big bottle? Oh, yeah. It was a pint. Was it like this size? Oh, yeah. It was about a pint. Maybe a little more. I would say a pint. But one funny incident happened while I was on this shore. We were playing in De Quoen, Illinois. And I wasn't a... I was living in a... I got me a room. Because I knew a couple of girls in this town. And I got a hold of some bad moonshine in De Quoen. And I got kind of sick. Man, I thought I was going to die. And this landlady calls up a doctor. And this is just a little before showtime. In the meantime, Doc wanted to know if I was coming to the show. And he came to this house just before... Just when this doctor was walking out. Doc seen this doctor with his case and everything. And he come running in the room and he says, Who's that fellow walking out there? And this lady, this landlady, she says, She says, Well, this Joe is real sick and everything. And I call the doctor and the dark moon says,

My reputation is ruined. Here I am, the greatest doctor in the world and everything. And this boy gets sick. One of my members of my own show. What a traitor. Calls in another doctor. All he had to do was take a drink of that moon's tonic and it would put him on his feet. I said, Doc, you better get out of here. He said, You're fired. But anyway, he didn't fire me. And,
